note: All 80 distinct entry URLs (115 entries, 10 hosts) were opened with WebFetch on 15 November 2026, asking for the page title, main heading, products and the drugs named (the PRO Test cannabinoids page was asked a second time for exact wording). None waited on an approval. WebFetch returns a page as text read by a small model, so remarks that a drug is 'not named' and remarks on stock rest on that reading. The sellers' home URLs were not opened, because no entry depends on them (DrogArt's is its entries' own URL); EZ Test has no entries. No WebSearch; no other host. Verdicts follow the brief: the page loads, is on the seller's own site and sells a test for that drug or the stated thing, and a fentanyl (xylazine, nitazene) strip page counts for the opioid and benzodiazepine pages. Entries confirmed as pages that still need the editor's decision carry 'Borderline' or 'Caveat' in their note: PRO Test synthetic-cannabinoids, Reduciendo Daño 5-meo-dmt and ghb-gbl, BTNX synthetic-cathinones; DrogArt's four entries share one general page that names each test. Stock when read: Reagent Tests UK's fentanyl strip showed 'Out of stock' (5 entries); NUAA's Cocaine Kit and MDMA Kit showed 'Sold out'; on NUAA's six other pages the text held both 'Add to cart' and 'Sold out' while the page data said in stock, so stock there is not known. BTNX: five product pages (COC300, AMP1000, a-PVP300, LSD50, PCP25) showed no price or cart button, only order-form and contact links, while GHB10000 and MET1000 showed a price and 'Add to Cart (Ship within Canada)'.
